front_blocks.md: When does a **river** flood?

cards.front_md: When does a **river** flood?

front_blocks.md: Why do **steep slopes** increase flood risk?

back_blocks.md: On steep slopes, rainwater flows quickly downhill and has **no time to infiltrate**, so river levels rise sharply.

cards.front_md: Why do **steep slopes** increase flood risk?

front_blocks.md: Why does **compacted soil** increase surface run-off?

back_blocks.md: Compacted soil has fewer **air spaces** to store water, so even light rain becomes surface run-off.

cards.front_md: Why does **compacted soil** increase surface run-off?
